quote.prompt:
I'll give you {free0} Bells
for {item0}. Sound good?

thanks.text:
Thank you! Pleasure doing
business with you!

full.text:
Oh my, you can't carry
that many Bells! Make some
room and come back, yes?

declined.text:
Oh, I see... Well, let me
know if you change your mind.

junk.text:
Hmm, I'm afraid that's not
worth anything. I'll take it
off your hands, though!

sunday.text:
I don't buy turnips on
Sundays. That's when Joan
comes by to sell them!

refused.text:
Hm? I can't take that
one, I'm afraid.
